data.title: Donald Trump defends US war with Iran in Oval Office interview | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "A year and a half ago, we were laughed at. They’re not laughing anymore,” said the US president, who in the interview defended his decision to start a war with Iran that is now in its fourth month.
